skillTricks.allowedNote: Non-magic, non-crafting skills; a racial skill only if it is one of the owner's racial skills.

skillSpecials.summary: Pick one specific performance; it affects a single target only.
10 Copper at check-in per trick slot used.
2 Basic Components at check-in per trick slot used; cannot harvest on plots but Hastens the owner's harvesting.

rules.retrainingNote: A Retraining Elixir empties 1 Trick Slot; new tricks are trained between events by email to the GM team.
rules.physRepNote: Approved phys rep needed before gaining the Familiar; commonly a plush of at least 4 inches.

specialTricks.name: Scouting
specialTricks.summary: A GM or Narrator gives a little information about what it sees.

specialTricks.name: Breath Weapon
specialTricks.summary: A Frontal Cone of either 25 <element> damage or 10 healing.

specialTricks.name: Assist
specialTricks.summary: Assist the owner (Hastened count) with a chosen action: Refit Armor, Tracking, Crafting, Healing, or non-group performances.

specialTricks.name: Use a Consumable
specialTricks.summary: Use a consumable for the owner hands-free.

specialTricks.name: Deliver
specialTricks.summary: Deliver a small item or note to a named person.

specialTricks.name: Detect Poison or Disease
specialTricks.summary: Detect Poison or Disease by scent on a 10-count.

specialTricks.name: Distraction
specialTricks.summary: Distract a foe, allowing an attack from any angle.

specialTricks.name: Speak with Dead
specialTricks.summary: Speak with Dead as the spell, but a one-word answer.

specialTricks.name: Resist Element
specialTricks.summary: Resist a chosen element (earth, air, fire, water, harm, essence).
